sources.finding: Official Chemistry EAP index explicitly links Pacific Hall to the PDF below.

Six pages: cover and emergency instructions on pages 1–5; the sole image on page 6 is an exterior assembly-area campus illustration. Page 6 was rendered and visually inspected. No room numbers or indoor boundaries.

Official reservation list identifies 4500 as Pacific Hall Theatre, 4501 as conference room and 4503 as meeting room. Calendar links do not supply polygons; the page says Chemistry membership and UCSD login are required for calendars, which were not opened.

limitations: The new EAP is a separate 2023 document, but its only map still covers outdoor evacuation assembly. It does not improve room placement.
Room capacity is not room area.
